short_bio: X-Press 2 is a London-based UK house outfit, originally the trio of Ashley Beedle, Darren Rock (Rocky) and Darren House (Diesel), later continuing as Rocky & Diesel. He has released acclaimed albums including Drowning in a Sea of Love, Hard Islands and Steam Days, later co-founding the Cambria Instruments label and issuing music via Ninja Tune.

name: Anderson Noise
short_bio: Brazilian DJ and producer from Belo Horizonte, Anderson Noise is a pioneer of Brazil’s techno scene. Active since the 1990s, he is known for driving techno and minimal/tech house sounds and for founding the Noise Music label.

They blend sleek synth-pop with microhouse and techno influences and have released acclaimed albums on Domino and City Slang. Key works include Last Exit, So This Is Goodbye, and Big Black Coat.

He broke through with 2001’s 'Sunglasses at Night' (with Zyntherius) and went on to release club staples like 'You Gonna Want Me,' 'Pleasure From the Bass,' 'Bugatti,' and 'Let's Go Dancing' with Audion.

name: Pascal F.E.O.S.

short_bio: German DJ and producer from the Frankfurt scene, Pascal F.E.O.S. (Pascal Dardoufas) was active from the early 1990s and became known for work on Eye Q and Harthouse as well as his own Planet Vision. He recorded as Sonic Infusion and was part of Resistance D and the ambient project Aural Float. He passed away in 2020.

Emerging from the Windsor/Detroit scene in the early 1990s via Plus 8 and Novamute, he became known for stark rhythms and 303-driven sound design across albums like Sheet One, Musik, Consumed and Closer; classic singles include Spastik.

name: Marc Antona
short_bio: Marc Antona is a French minimal/tech house producer and DJ associated with the Dissonant label. His productions are known for deep, rolling grooves and refined percussive detail.

name: Telefon Tel Aviv

short_bio: Telefon Tel Aviv is an American electronic act formed in New Orleans by Joshua Eustis and Charles Cooper. They debuted with Fahrenheit Fair Enough on Hefty in 2001 and became known for a blend of IDM, glitch and ambient across albums including Map of What Is Effortless and Immolate Yourself. Following Cooper’s death in 2009, Eustis revived the project for Dreams Are Not Enough on Ghostly International in 2019.

notable_releases: Mucky Star; Pleasure Seeker; You're My Kind; Don't Go

name: Deadbeat

short_bio: Deadbeat is the alias of Canadian producer Scott Monteith, a Berlin-based artist known for richly textured dub techno. He emerged in the early 2000s on ~scape and Wagon Repair and later founded his BLKRTZ label. Collaborations with Paul St. Hilaire and albums like Drawn and Quartered and Walls and Dimensions cemented his standing in modern dub techno.

name: Slam
styles: techno; minimal techno; tech house; house
notable_releases: Positive Education; Lifetimes; This World; Headstates (album); Alien Radio (album)

notable_releases: Energetic; Watergate 14

They became known in the 2000s for quirky, groove-led minimal and tech-house productions and distinctive remixes, including their acclaimed take on Slam's This World.

He founded 100% Pure and co-founded Intacto Records (with Shinedoe), as well as the Remote Area family of labels, helping shape the modern tech house sound. Known for peak-time cuts like Spanish Fly and Tropical Melons.

He has released and mixed on labels such as Ostgut Ton and Cocoon, and has collaborated with artists including Guido Schneider and Paul Brtschitsch (as Taksi). He also co-runs the ARAS label.

name: Sun Electric

short_bio: Sun Electric is a Berlin-based electronic duo of Max Loderbauer and Tom Thiel. Active since the early 1990s, they are known for lush ambient techno and IDM releases on Apollo/R&S, including the albums Kitchen, Present and the live set 30.7.94 Live.

name: Akiko Kiyama

short_bio: Funkagenda is UK DJ/producer Adam Walder, best known for tech and progressive house on labels like Toolroom. He broke through in the late 2000s and is widely recognized for the Mark Knight collaboration “Man With The Red Face” and solo tracks such as “What The Fuck.”

name: Miss Fitz

short_bio: Miss Fitz is an alias of Israeli-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer Maayan Nidam, known for stripped-back minimal house and tech house. She is also half of the duo Mara Trax with Vera.

name: Dario Zenker
short_bio: German techno DJ and producer from Munich, co-founder of Ilian Tape alongside his brother Marco. He releases solo and as part of Zenker Brothers, known for deep, dub-influenced Munich techno.

name: Reboot
notable_releases: Caminando
short_bio: Reboot is the German DJ and producer Frank Heinrich from Frankfurt, known for percussive minimal techno and tech house. He rose to prominence in the late 2000s with releases on labels like Cadenza and Cécille. His track Caminando became a key cut of the era.

name: Booka Shade
styles: tech house; minimal techno; electro house
notable_releases: Body Language (with M.A.N.D.Y.); Mandarine Girl; In White Rooms; Movements (album); The Sun & The Neon Light (album)
short_bio: Booka Shade is the German house/tech-house duo of Walter Merziger and Arno Kammermeier, originally from Frankfurt am Main. They co-founded the label Get Physical Music and broke through in the mid-2000s with tracks like Body Language, Mandarine Girl and In White Rooms and the album Movements.

name: Chloé
associated_labels: Lumière Noire Records; Kill The DJ; Karat Records
styles: minimal techno; tech house; house; electro
notable_releases: The Waiting Room; Endless Revisions
short_bio: Chloé Thévenin is a Paris-based DJ, producer and composer known for atmospheric minimal techno and house. A key figure in the Kill The DJ milieu, she later founded Lumière Noire Records and released albums including The Waiting Room and Endless Revisions.

name: From Karaoke To Stardom
short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

name: The Deepshakerz
associated_labels: Safe Music; Defected; DFTD; Toolroom; Cajual
short_bio: The Deepshakerz are an Italian house/tech-house duo of Domy Berardino and Mirco Sonatore from Bari. They run the Safe Music label and have released on imprints such as Defected/DFTD, Toolroom and Cajual.

name: Black Strobe
notable_releases: Me and Madonna; The Abwehr Disco; I'm A Man; Italian Fireflies; Burn Your Own Church (album)
short_bio: Black Strobe is a Parisian electronic act formed in 1997 by Arnaud Rebotini and Ivan Smagghe, known for a dark, EBM-influenced electroclash sound. Early singles on Output Recordings led to cult hits like Me and Madonna, and their blues-charged cover I'm A Man broadened their reach; later the project continued under Rebotini.

name: John Selway
associated_acts: Christian Smith; Smith & Selway; The Horrorist; Disintegrator
notable_releases: Total Departure; Move!
short_bio: New York-based American DJ and producer known for driving techno and tech house, both solo and as half of Smith & Selway with Christian Smith. He has released on labels such as Drumcode and Tronic and runs the CSM imprint. Active since the 1990s.

name: Guido Schneider
associated_acts: Jens Bond; André Galluzzi; Florian Schirmacher; Glowing Glisses
short_bio: German DJ and producer known for refined minimal/tech house, closely associated with Poker Flat Recordings. Active in the Berlin scene, he has collaborated with Jens Bond and worked as part of Glowing Glisses with vocalist Florian Schirmacher.

notable_releases: Love Dose; Tataki; Pantheon (with Goom Gum)
short_bio: Greek DJ and producer active since the mid-2000s, Argy broke through with Love Dose on Poker Flat and later released on Afterlife. His sound spans stripped tech-house roots through to modern melodic techno, with widely played tracks like Tataki and Pantheon (with Goom Gum).

name: Butch
associated_labels: bouq.; Cécille Records; Desolat; Great Stuff Recordings; Trapez
notable_releases: No Worries; Amelie; Countach; Dope
short_bio: German DJ/producer Bülent Gürler, known as Butch, is a Mainz-based figure in tech house and minimal techno. He co-founded the bouq. label and has released on Cécille, Desolat, Great Stuff and Trapez, with club hits like No Worries and Amelie.

name: Tyrone Palmer
notable_releases: Slam - This World (feat. Tyrone Palmer); Slam - Lifetimes (feat. Tyrone Palmer)
short_bio: Tyrone Palmer is a vocalist known in the techno/house scene for collaborations with Scottish duo Slam on Soma Records, including the singles Lifetimes and This World.

name: Hermanez
short_bio: DJ and producer known for tech house and minimal techno.

name: Grindvik
notable_releases: Monuments; Isle Of Real
short_bio: Swedish techno producer and DJ, founder of the Stockholm LTD label. Known for driving, emotive techno and releases like Monuments and the 2016 album Isle Of Real.

name: Marc Houle
associated_acts: Magda; Troy Pierce; Run Stop Restore; Richie Hawtin
notable_releases: Techno Vocals; Restore; Drift; Undercover; Restored
short_bio: Canadian minimal techno producer and live performer from the Windsor/Detroit scene. Long-time Minus artist and co-founder of Items & Things with Magda and Troy Pierce, he is known for analog, melodic minimal and tracks like Techno Vocals and albums such as Restore and Drift.

name: Anthony Collins
styles: deep house; minimal house; tech house
short_bio: French-born DJ and producer in the minimal/deep house scene, active since the late 2000s. He later co-founded the Scissor & Thread label with Francis Harris as the duo Frank & Tony.

name: Âme
styles: deep house; tech house; minimal techno; house; techno
notable_releases: Rej; Where We At (feat. Derrick Carter); Howling – Howling (Âme Remix); Dream House (album)
short_bio: Âme is a German duo of Kristian Beyer and Frank Wiedemann, best known for deep, melodic house/techno and for co-founding the Berlin-based label Innervisions with Dixon. They broke through with the 2005 anthem Rej and have remained influential as DJs, producers and curators.

name: Justin Martin
notable_releases: The Sad Piano; Mr. Spock (with Ardalan); Lezgo (with Ardalan); Ghettos & Gardens (album); Hello Clouds (album)
short_bio: American DJ/producer from San Francisco and a core member of the Dirtybird crew. Debuted with The Sad Piano on Ben Watt's Buzzin' Fly in 2003 and became known for bass-heavy, melody-rich tech house. Albums include Ghettos & Gardens (2012) and Hello Clouds (2016), both on Dirtybird.

name: Alex

name: Señor Coconut And His Orchestra

short_bio: Señor Coconut And His Orchestra is the Latin big-band project of German producer Uwe Schmidt (aka Atom™), based in Santiago, Chile. The act is known for mambo/cha-cha renditions of electronic and pop classics, including tributes to Kraftwerk and Yellow Magic Orchestra. Key releases include El Baile Alemán (1997), Fiesta Songs (2003), and Yellow Fever! (2006), which features the cover Behind The Mask.

name: Navid Tahernia

short_bio: German DJ and producer from Leipzig known for sleek, groove-led tech house and minimal techno. He has released key records on Moon Harbour, Cocoon and Freude am Tanzen, including tracks like Say It Loud and Confidence.

name: Peter Grummich
short_bio: German electronic music producer and DJ associated with the early-2000s minimal techno and tech house scenes. Known for releases on Kompakt and Shitkatapult.

name: Jeff Samuel

short_bio: German producer Daso Franke, known simply as Daso, made melodic minimal/tech house for labels like My Best Friend and Connaisseur. He frequently collaborated with Pawas; his track “Thujon” is among his best-known cuts.

name: P. Osuna
short_bio: Spanish DJ and producer known for minimal techno and tech house. Founder of Mindshake Records.

name: Depeche Mode
associated_labels: Mute Records; Sire Records; Reprise Records; Columbia Records
styles: synth-pop; new wave; electronic; dark wave; alternative rock
notable_releases: Enjoy the Silence; Personal Jesus; Just Can't Get Enough; Violator (album); Music for the Masses (album)
short_bio: Depeche Mode are an English electronic band from Basildon, formed in 1980, whose core members have included Dave Gahan, Martin Gore and the late Andy Fletcher (with Vince Clarke an early member). They helped define synth-pop and darker electronic music, achieving global success with albums like Violator and hit singles such as Enjoy the Silence and Personal Jesus.

name: Andre Kraml
notable_releases: Safari; Safari (James Holden Remix)
short_bio: German minimal/tech house producer best known for the mid-2000s track Safari featuring Shad Privat, which gained wide recognition through James Holden’s remix. Released music on Cologne’s Platzhirsch Schallplatten.

name: Joris Voorn
styles: tech house; techno; minimal techno; house; melodic techno
notable_releases: Ringo; Incident (Miyagi); Future History; Nobody Knows; Balance 014 (Joris Voorn)
short_bio: Dutch DJ and producer based in Amsterdam, co-founder of the Green and Rejected labels with Edwin Oosterwal. Emerged in the early 2000s with releases on Sino and his own imprints, and gained wide acclaim with his Balance 014 mix and tracks like Ringo and Incident. His sound spans techno, tech house and melodic variants.

name: Nhar
short_bio: Electronic music producer and DJ known for melodic, minimal-leaning techno and tech house.

name: MiniCoolBoyz
short_bio: Italian duo known for minimal techno and tech house, associated with Dubfire’s SCI+TEC Digital Audio and with running their own imprint Amazing Records.

name: Claude VonStroke
associated_acts: Get Real; Green Velvet; Justin Martin
notable_releases: Who's Afraid of Detroit?; Deep Throat; The Whistler; Beware of the Bird; Urban Animal
short_bio: Claude VonStroke is the alias of American DJ and producer Barclay Crenshaw, founder of San Francisco’s Dirtybird label. Rising in the mid-2000s with quirky, bass-heavy tech house, he’s known for tracks like “Deep Throat” and “Who’s Afraid of Detroit?” and albums including “Beware of the Bird” and “Urban Animal.” He also collaborates with Green Velvet as the duo Get Real.

name: Citizen Kain
short_bio: Citizen Kain is a French techno/tech house producer and DJ. He has released on Stil vor Talent, runs the Neverending label, and frequently collaborates with fellow French artist Kiko.

name: Rework
notable_releases: Love Love Love Yeah
short_bio: German minimal house act associated with Playhouse, best known for the track Love Love Love Yeah.

name: Workidz
notable_releases: Washmachine
short_bio: House project best known for the club track 'Washmachine'.

name: Agnes
short_bio: Swiss producer and DJ known for deep and minimal house. Also records under the alias Ray Valioso and has released on Sthlmaudio Recordings.

name: Delhia
short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

name: Nick Curly
styles: tech house; deep house; minimal techno
notable_releases: Underground; Zanzibar; Pujante; Between The Lines (album)
short_bio: Nick Curly is a German DJ and producer from Mannheim, central to the city’s tech house and deep house scene. He co-founded 8bit Records and Cécille Records and rose to prominence with sleek, groove-led productions. Notable works include Underground, Zanzibar, Pujante, and the album Between The Lines.

name: Chris Liebing
notable_releases: Bangbop; Stigmata (series); Collabs 3000: Metalism; Burn Slow; Another Day
short_bio: German techno DJ, producer and label owner, best known as the founder of CLR and co-creator of the Stigmata project with André Walter. He is a key figure of hard, driving techno and has collaborated extensively with Speedy J (Collabs 3000), while later releasing albums such as Burn Slow and Another Day on Mute.

name: Guy Gerber
associated_labels: Supplement Facts; Rumors; Cocoon Recordings; Bedrock Records; Visionquest
styles: tech house; minimal techno; deep house
notable_releases: Stoppage Time; Late Bloomers; The Mirror Game; What To Do; 11 11 (with Puff Daddy)
short_bio: Israeli DJ and producer from Tel Aviv, founder of the Supplement Facts and Rumors labels, known for a melodic, emotive strain of house and techno. He has released on Cocoon, Bedrock and Visionquest and collaborated with Puff Daddy.

name: Luciano
associated_labels: Cadenza Records; Perlon; Mental Groove; Soma
associated_acts: Quenum; Ricardo Villalobos; Pier Bucci; Dandy Jack
styles: minimal house; tech house; minimal techno
notable_releases: Orange Mistake (with Quenum); Rise of Angel; Tribute to the Sun (album); Fabric 41: Luciano (mix); Sci.Fi.Hi.Fi. Vol. 2 (mix)
short_bio: Chilean–Swiss DJ and producer, founder of Cadenza Records and a key figure in minimal house and tech house since the early 2000s. Known for Latin-inflected, groove-driven productions and collaborations with peers such as Quenum.

name: Steve Bug
associated_labels: Poker Flat Recordings; Dessous Recordings; Audiomatique Recordings; Raw Elements
styles: tech house; minimal house; deep house; minimal techno
notable_releases: Loverboy; Paradise Sold (with Langenberg); Never Ending Winding Roads; Bugnology
short_bio: German DJ/producer and label owner, founder of Poker Flat Recordings (as well as Dessous and Audiomatique). Berlin-based and active since the mid-1990s, he is known for stripped-back house and tech-house, including the classic 'Loverboy'.

name: Matthias Tanzmann
associated_acts: Better Lost Than Stupid; Davide Squillace; Martin Buttrich; Gamat 3000; Daniel Scholz
styles: tech house; minimal house; deep house
notable_releases: Restless (album); Momentum (album)
short_bio: German DJ and producer from Leipzig, founder of Moon Harbour Recordings. A key figure in tech house and long-time Circoloco resident at DC-10 Ibiza. Member of Better Lost Than Stupid and formerly part of the duo Gamat 3000.

name: Mark Henning
associated_labels: Soma Records; Clink Recordings; Safari Electronique; Trapez
notable_releases: Jupiter Jive
short_bio: UK-born DJ and producer based in Berlin, known for minimal techno and tech house. He has released on labels such as Soma Records, Clink and Safari Electronique, including the album Jupiter Jive.

name: Cassy
associated_labels: Perlon; Ostgut Ton; Kwench Records; Aus Music; Fabric
styles: minimal house; deep house; tech house
notable_releases: Panorama Bar 01 (Ostgut Ton, 2006); fabric 71: Cassy (2013); Donna (Aus Music, 2016); Swayzak feat. Cassy - Smile and Receive (2007)
short_bio: Cassy (Catherine Britton) is an Austrian DJ, producer and vocalist closely associated with Berlin’s Panorama Bar and labels like Perlon and Ostgut Ton. She has released the mix CDs Panorama Bar 01 and fabric 71, launched her own imprint Kwench Records, and issued her debut album Donna on Aus Music. She has also appeared as a vocalist with Swayzak.

name: M.A.N.D.Y.
notable_releases: Body Language (with Booka Shade); O Superman (vs. Booka Shade)
short_bio: M.A.N.D.Y. is a German DJ/producer duo of Patrick Bodmer and Philipp Jung. They co-founded the Berlin-based label Get Physical Music alongside Booka Shade and DJ T., and are known for influential tech-house releases such as Body Language with Booka Shade.

name: Billy Dalessandro
styles: minimal techno; tech house; acid techno
short_bio: Chicago-based electronic music producer and DJ known for minimal techno, tech house and acid-leaning releases within the US Midwest underground.

name: Chaim
associated_labels: BPitch Control; Supplement Facts; Blue Shadow Records
short_bio: Israeli DJ and producer from Tel Aviv known for deep, melodic house and tech house, with releases on BPitch Control and Supplement Facts. He is closely tied to the Tel Aviv scene and has collaborated with Jenia Tarsol.

name: Matt John
associated_labels: Perlon; Cocoon Recordings; Sleep Is Commercial; Bar25
notable_releases: The Keys
short_bio: Berlin-based German DJ and producer associated with the city’s minimal/microhouse and tech-house scene, with releases on Perlon, Sleep Is Commercial and Cocoon. Closely linked to the Bar25 milieu, he released the album The Keys on Cocoon.

name: Benjamin Fehr
short_bio: German minimal techno producer and DJ, founder of Catenaccio Records.

name: Tiefschwarz
associated_labels: Souvenir Music; Four Music; Fine; Classic Recordings
styles: house; deep house; tech house; minimal techno
notable_releases: Nix; Damage (feat. Tracey Thorn); Warning Siren (feat. Seth Troxler); RAL 9005; Eat Books
short_bio: Tiefschwarz are German brothers Ali and Basti Schwarz from Stuttgart, a duo known for deep and tech house since the late 1990s. They founded the Souvenir Music label and have released on Classic, Four Music and Fine, with acclaimed albums RAL 9005 and Eat Books.

name: Hobo
notable_releases: Failsafe
short_bio: Hobo is Canadian producer Joel Boychuk, known for minimal techno and tech house releases on Richie Hawtin’s Minus label. His track “Failsafe” is among his best-known productions.

name: Pfirter
associated_labels: MindTrip; CLR; Stroboscopic Artefacts; Figure; Stockholm LTD
short_bio: Argentine techno DJ/producer Juan Pablo Pfirter is the founder of the MindTrip label and podcast, known for hypnotic, driving techno. He has released on MindTrip, CLR, Stroboscopic Artefacts, Figure and Stockholm LTD.

name: Shackleton
associated_labels: Skull Disco; Perlon; Woe To The Septic Heart!; Mordant Music; Fabric
styles: dubstep; minimal techno; experimental techno; bass music; tribal
notable_releases: Blood on My Hands; Death Is Not Final; Three EPs; Music For The Quiet Hour / The Drawbar Organ EPs; Fabric 55: Shackleton
short_bio: Shackleton is English producer Sam Shackleton, co-founder of the Skull Disco label with Appleblim. Emerging from the mid‑2000s UK dubstep scene, he developed a hypnotic, percussive and experimental sound, later releasing on Perlon and his own Woe To The Septic Heart!. Noted works include Blood on My Hands, Death Is Not Final, Three EPs, and Music For The Quiet Hour / The Drawbar Organ EPs.

name: Roy Horten
short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

name: False
short_bio: False is the minimal techno alias of American producer Matthew Dear. He has released primarily on Richie Hawtin's Minus and Plus 8 labels, including the album 2007.

name: Damian Schwartz
short_bio: Madrid-based Spanish producer and DJ associated with the Net28 collective. Known for minimal/tech-house releases on labels such as Apnea and Net28.

name: Jens Bond
notable_releases: Consequence
short_bio: Jens Bond is a Berlin-based German DJ and producer known for minimal techno and tech house. He has released on Highgrade Records and Sender Records and is associated with the track Consequence.

name: Luca Bacchetti
notable_releases: What Ever; El Matador; Caribbean
short_bio: Italian DJ and producer known for sleek tech house and minimal releases on labels such as Ovum and Wagon Repair. He later established the Endless imprint, expanding into a more melodic and cinematic sound.

name: Gel Abril
associated_labels: Be As One Imprint; Ovum Recordings
notable_releases: Miranda
short_bio: Israeli DJ and producer from Tel Aviv known for driving tech-house and techno. Emerged in the late 2000s with key releases on Shlomi Aber’s Be As One Imprint and Josh Wink’s Ovum Recordings.

name: Ellen Allien
styles: techno; minimal techno; tech house; electro
notable_releases: Stadtkind; Berlinette; Thrills; Orchestra of Bubbles (with Apparat); Alientronic
short_bio: Berlin-based DJ, producer and BPitch Control founder, Ellen Allien (Ellen Fraatz) is a pivotal figure in German techno since the mid-1990s. Her acclaimed albums include Stadtkind, Berlinette and Alientronic, alongside the collaboration with Apparat, Orchestra of Bubbles. Known for a distinctive blend of techno, minimal and electro.

name: Nihad Tule
short_bio: Stockholm-based techno producer and DJ known for streamlined, hypnotic techno and releases on Stockholm LTD.

name: Maxime Dangles
notable_releases: My Head
short_bio: French techno producer and DJ associated with Kompakt, known for the track "My Head." Member of the trio Möd3rn with Electric Rescue and Traumer. He also records under the alias DNGLS and has released on Kompakt and Skryptöm.

name: Paul Ritch
associated_labels: Quartz Rec; Drumcode; SCI+TEC Digital Audio; Resopal Schallware
notable_releases: Winter Ceremony; Split the Line; Evil Laff; Messene
short_bio: French techno DJ and producer from Paris, active since the mid-2000s. He founded the label Quartz Rec and released on imprints like Drumcode and SCI+TEC, with breakout tracks such as Winter Ceremony and Split the Line.

name: Soylent Green
notable_releases: La Forza Del Destino; Low Pt. 1 + 2
short_bio: Soylent Green is an alias of German producer Roman Flügel, associated with the Frankfurt house scene. Under this moniker he released deep, classic house on labels like Playhouse/Klang, including the standout track La Forza Del Destino.

name: Gary Beck
associated_labels: Soma Records; Drumcode; BEK Audio; Saved Records
notable_releases: Say What; Bring A Friend
short_bio: Scottish techno DJ and producer from Glasgow, Gary Beck is known for high-impact club tracks and releases on Soma Records, Drumcode, and his own BEK Audio. His work includes the album Bring A Friend and the widely played single Say What.

name: Audio Injection
associated_acts: Drumcell; Raíz; Cell Injection; Droid Behavior
short_bio: Audio Injection is the techno alias of Los Angeles producer/DJ David Flores, also known as Truncate. A key member of the Droid Behavior family, he released minimal-leaning US techno on Droid Recordings and has collaborated with Drumcell as Cell Injection.

name: Recloose
associated_acts: Carl Craig; Dwele; Fat Freddy's Drop
notable_releases: So This Is The Dining Room (EP); Cardiology (album); Hiatus on the Horizon (album); Can't Take It (feat. Dwele); Landed
short_bio: Detroit-born producer Matthew Chicoine, aka Recloose, emerged in the late 1990s after Carl Craig picked up his demo and released his early work on Planet E. Known for jazzy, soulful Detroit house, he later relocated to New Zealand and collaborated with members of Fat Freddy's Drop and Dwele. Key releases include So This Is The Dining Room, Cardiology, Hiatus on the Horizon, and the tracks Can't Take It and Landed.

name: Click Click

short_bio: Colder is the project of Paris-based French artist Marc Nguyen Tan. short_bio: Reset Robot is the alias of UK producer and DJ Dave Robertson from Portsmouth. Known for sleek, groove-led techno and tech house, he has released on Truesoul and Dubfire’s SCI+TEC and frequently collaborates with Alan Fitzpatrick.

short_bio: Apparat is the alias of German producer Sascha Ring, a Berlin-based artist known for atmospheric electronica spanning ambient, IDM and techno. He is one third of Moderat alongside Modeselektor and has released key works on Shitkatapult, BPitch Control and Mute. Notable releases include Walls, The Devil's Walk and the singles Arcadia and Goodbye.

name: Swayzak

notable_releases: Snowboarding in Argentina; Dirty Dancing; Loops From The Bergerie; Some Other Country; Smile and Receive
short_bio: Swayzak is a London-based UK electronic duo of James S. Taylor and David Brown, active since the late 1990s and known for minimal techno and tech house. name: Darko Esser
short_bio: Dutch DJ/producer from Nijmegen, founder of Wolfskuil Records, also known as Tripeo. Active in techno and tech house; he has also run the Balans imprint.

short_bio: Danish producer and DJ Rune Reilly Kölsch, known early as Rune/Rune RK and later as Kölsch, is behind the club classic 'Calabria' and releases melodic techno on Kompakt as Kölsch. Based in Copenhagen, he also records as part of the project Enur.

name: Delete
short_bio: Venezuelan producer Sergio Muñoz released minimal and tech house under the moniker Delete, and later co-founded the duo Fur Coat with Israel Sunshine.

name: Konrad Black
short_bio: Canadian DJ and producer associated with the Vancouver minimal techno scene and the Wagon Repair label. Known for deep, moody minimal techno and tech house with longstanding ties to Mathew Jonson.

name: Kiki

short_bio: Finnish-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer on BPitch Control known for sleek, electro-tinged minimal techno and tech house. He has released the albums Run With Me and Kaiku on the label.

name: Simon Baker
notable_releases: Plastik; Traces
short_bio: UK DJ and producer from Leeds known for deep and tech house, with key releases on 20:20 Vision and Leftroom. His track Plastik and the album Traces are among his best-known works.

name: JPLS
notable_releases: Twilite (album); Green series (EPs); Program EP
short_bio: Minimal techno producer associated with Richie Hawtin’s Minus label. Known for the album Twilite and a run of stripped, percussive EPs including the Green series and Program.

name: Len Faki

notable_releases: Mekong Delta; My Black Sheep; BX 3; Berghain 03
short_bio: Berlin-based techno DJ and producer, founder of the Figure label and a long-time Berghain resident. He has released key EPs on Ostgut Ton including 'Mekong Delta' and 'My Black Sheep', and compiled the Berghain 03 mix.

name: Laurie Anderson
associated_acts: Lou Reed; Brian Eno; Kronos Quartet; Peter Gabriel; William S. Burroughs; John Giorno
styles: avant-garde; experimental; art pop; electronic; spoken word

short_bio: Laurie Anderson is an American avant‑garde composer, musician and performance artist based in New York City. She gained international recognition with the 1981 single O Superman and the album Big Science. Her work blends electronic sound design and spoken word, and she has collaborated with figures such as Brian Eno, Kronos Quartet, and her late husband Lou Reed.

name: Playgroup
notable_releases: Playgroup (album); Number One; Front 2 Back; Make It Happen; DJ-Kicks: Playgroup
short_bio: Playgroup is the dance project of London producer Trevor Jackson, founder of Output Recordings. Emerging in the early 2000s, the project fused electro, house and disco, yielding a self-titled album and a DJ-Kicks mix for !K7 alongside club tracks like Number One and Front 2 Back.

short_bio: Radio Slave is the primary moniker of British DJ/producer Matt Edwards, co-founder of the Rekids label. Renowned for hypnotic, loop-driven techno and tech house, he has released influential tracks like Grindhouse and Don't Stop No Sleep and mixed Fabric 48. He also records as Rekid and forms the duo Quiet Village with Joel Martin.

name: Alex Under
short_bio: Spanish producer and DJ from Madrid known for sleek, percussive minimal techno and tech-house. He has been closely associated with the Spanish imprints CMYKmusik and Apnea, with releases also on Trapez. Active since the 2000s within Spain’s minimal/tech-house scene.

name: Lucio Aquilina
notable_releases: Magic M; I Saw U

short_bio: Adultnapper is the long-running alias of New York producer and DJ Francis Harris, known for moody minimal and tech house on Poker Flat and its sublabel Audiomatique in the 2000s. He collaborated with Mr. C as Sycophant Slags and later formed the Frank & Tony project with Anthony Collins.

name: James Holden
associated_acts: Nathan Fake; Luke Abbott; James Holden & The Animal Spirits; Holden & Thompson; Maalem Mahmoud Guinia
styles: minimal techno; progressive house; experimental electronic
notable_releases: A Break in the Clouds; The Sky Was Pink (James Holden Remix); The Idiots Are Winning; The Inheritors; The Animal Spirits
short_bio: James Holden is a British electronic musician, DJ and producer, and the founder of the Border Community label. Emerging at the turn of the 2000s with progressive house and trance, he is widely known for his remix of Nathan Fake’s The Sky Was Pink and his albums The Idiots Are Winning and The Inheritors. He later formed James Holden & The Animal Spirits to explore live, improvisational electronics.

name: Quenum
notable_releases: Orange Mistake (with Luciano)
short_bio: Philippe Quenum is a Swiss DJ and producer from Geneva, best known as co‑founder of Cadenza Records with Luciano. Their track "Orange Mistake" launched the label and became a landmark minimal techno release. Quenum is recognized for sleek, groove-led minimal techno and tech house, and frequent collaborations including work with Lee Van Dowski.

name: Señor Coconut
aliases: Señor Coconut y su Conjunto; Señor Coconut and His Orchestra
notable_releases: El Baile Alemán (album, 2000); Fiesta Songs (album, 2003); Yellow Fever! (album, 2006)
short_bio: Señor Coconut is the Latin-electronic project of German producer Uwe Schmidt, launched after his move to Santiago de Chile. The project is best known for tropical big-band reinterpretations of classics, notably the Kraftwerk tribute album El Baile Alemán (2000), followed by Fiesta Songs and Yellow Fever!. Releases have appeared on Essay Recordings and Schmidt’s Rather Interesting imprint.

name: Tolga Fidan

name: Martin Eyerer
short_bio: German DJ and producer known for tech house and techno. He co-founded the Kling Klong label.

name: Monika Kruse

short_bio: German techno DJ and producer based in Berlin, Monika Kruse is the founder of Terminal M Records and a longstanding figure in European club culture. Active since the 1990s, she has released and collaborated widely, including the project Monika Kruse @ Voodooamt, and issued the album Traces on her label.

name: Phunklarique

short_bio: Super Flu is a German tech house duo from Halle (Saale), known for playful, melodic club productions. They are closely associated with the Monaberry label, with standout tracks like Jo Gurt.

name: Gui Boratto

notable_releases: Chromophobia (2007); Beautiful Life; No Turning Back; Take My Breath Away (2009); Arquipélago
short_bio: Gui Boratto is a Brazilian producer and composer from São Paulo, best known as a key artist on Kompakt. He broke through with his album Chromophobia (2007), delivering melodic, emotive techno and tech house hits like Beautiful Life and No Turning Back. He also runs the D.O.C. imprint and frequently collaborates with vocalist Luciana Villanova.

name: Italoboyz
styles: minimal house; tech house; minimal techno
notable_releases: Viktor Casanova; Zinga; Bahia
short_bio: Italian duo Italoboyz (Marco Donato and Federico Marton) emerged from the minimal/tech house scene and based themselves in London. They became known for quirky, sample-led releases on Mothership and Moon Harbour, most notably the underground hit Viktor Casanova.

name: Uto Karem
short_bio: Italian techno DJ and producer, founder of Agile Recordings.

name: Mikael Stavöstrand
short_bio: Swedish producer known for minimal techno and microhouse, active since the late 1990s. He has released on labels such as Mitek, Contexterrior and Adjunct Audio, and later based himself in Los Angeles. His work focuses on reduced grooves and experimental textures.

name: Innersphere
notable_releases: Phunk
short_bio: Innersphere is an alias of Amsterdam-based DJ/producer Shinedoe, best known for the mid-2000s minimal/tech house anthem 'Phunk'.

name: Davide Squillace

short_bio: Italian DJ and producer from Naples, central to the Neapolitan techno movement. Known for sleek tech house and minimal productions, he runs the labels This And That Lab and Minisketch and has released on Cadenza and Desolat. He is also part of the trio Better Lost Than Stupid with Matthias Tanzmann and Martin Buttrich.

name: Heartthrob

short_bio: Heartthrob is the alias of American producer Jesse Siminski, a key figure from Richie Hawtin’s Minus roster who later launched his own imprint ISNISNT. Emerging in the mid‑2000s, he is known for sleek minimal techno and tech-house, including the breakout single Baby Kate and the album Dear Painter, Paint Me.

short_bio: Winx is an alias of Philadelphia DJ/producer Josh Wink (Joshua Winkelman). Under the Winx name he released influential 1990s acid house/techno tracks including "Don't Laugh" and "Are You There?". He also co-founded the Ovum Recordings label.

notable_releases: Open System (album, 2001); Play It Loud! (album, 2011); Question (EP series)
short_bio: Marco Carola is an Italian DJ and producer from Naples, a key figure in the Neapolitan techno movement. He founded labels such as Design Music, Question and Zenit, later releasing the album Play It Loud! on M_nus and launching the Music On brand in Ibiza. Known for driving, minimalist grooves, he bridges techno and tech house in long-form DJ sets.

name: Sleeparchive
notable_releases: ACD-Voice
short_bio: Sleeparchive is the minimal techno project of Berlin-based producer Roger Semsroth. Emerging in the mid‑2000s, he is known for stark, loop-driven tracks and releases on his own Sleeparchive imprint as well as Tresor.

name: Dan Curtin
notable_releases: The Silicon Dawn
short_bio: American producer and DJ from Cleveland, active since the early 1990s. He founded the Metamorphic Recordings label and released influential work on Peacefrog Records. His music spans techno, house and electro.

name: Dustin Zahn
notable_releases: Stranger (To Stability)
short_bio: American techno DJ and producer from Minneapolis. Founder of Enemy Records and known for the club anthem "Stranger (To Stability)". Has released on labels including Rekids and Drumcode.

short_bio: House DJ and producer known for the anthem 'Jesus Creates Sound'.

name: Matthew Dear
styles: minimal techno; microhouse; tech house; leftfield pop
notable_releases: Audion - Mouth to Mouth; Leave Luck to Heaven; Asa Breed; Black City; Tiga vs Audion - Let's Go Dancing
short_bio: Matthew Dear is an American electronic producer, DJ, and vocalist from the Detroit/Ann Arbor scene, and a co-founder of Ghostly International and its dance imprint Spectral Sound. Under his own name and as Audion he helped define 2000s minimal techno and microhouse, later expanding into leftfield pop on his albums. Key works include Leave Luck to Heaven, Asa Breed, Black City, and Audion’s club classic Mouth to Mouth.

name: Heinrichs & Hirtenfellner
short_bio: Heinrichs & Hirtenfellner are a Berlin-based German duo associated with Highgrade Records, known for minimal techno and tech house releases.

name: D'Julz
notable_releases: Da Madness
short_bio: Parisian DJ and producer Julien Veniel, better known as D'Julz, is a key figure of the French house scene. He founded the long-running Bass Culture night at Paris's Rex Club and the Bass Culture Records label, with releases on imprints such as Ovum. His sound focuses on deep, groovy house and tech house.

name: Miss Kittin
associated_labels: International Deejay Gigolo Records; NovaMute; Nobody's Bizzness
associated_acts: The Hacker; Miss Kittin & The Hacker; Golden Boy; Felix da Housecat
notable_releases: Frank Sinatra; 1982; Rippin Kittin; Professional Distortion; First Album
short_bio: French DJ, producer and vocalist Caroline Hervé, aka Miss Kittin, rose from the late-1990s electroclash scene with The Hacker, issuing classics like Frank Sinatra and 1982 on International Deejay Gigolo Records. She later pursued a solo career with albums such as I Com and collaborated on hits like Rippin Kittin (with Golden Boy) and Silver Screen Shower Scene (with Felix da Housecat).

name: Dachshund
styles: minimal techno; tech house; deep house
short_bio: Dachshund is a Swiss DJ and producer from Geneva known for minimal and tech house. He co-founded the Geneva-based label Clapper with Quenum.

short_bio: Austrian techno producer, DJ and sound designer based in Berlin, and the founder of FLASH Recordings and the Riemann Kollektion. Active in the European techno scene with releases spanning techno, minimal and tech house.

name: Chris Carrier
associated_labels: Adult Only; Catwash Records; Robsoul Recordings
short_bio: French DJ/producer from Paris known for groove-driven house and tech house. He runs the Adult Only label and has released on Robsoul and Catwash Records.

short_bio: Someone Else is the minimal techno/tech-house project of American producer Sean O'Neal from Philadelphia. He co-founded the labels Foundsound and Unfoundsound.

name: Tom Budden
notable_releases: The Tree Dance
short_bio: UK DJ/producer and label owner behind ALiVE Recordings, known for tech house releases including 'The Tree Dance'.

name: Hardfloor
notable_releases: Acperience 1; TB Resuscitation; Home Run; New Order – Blue Monday (Hardfloor Mix); Mory Kante – Yé ké yé ké (Hardfloor Remix)
short_bio: Hardfloor is a German acid techno duo from Düsseldorf, formed by producers Oliver Bondzio and Ramon Zenker. Renowned for their multi-TB-303 sound and releases on Harthouse, they broke through with Acperience 1 in 1992 and delivered iconic remixes such as New Order’s Blue Monday.

name: Daniel Sanchez
associated_labels: Bla Bla Records; Remote Area; 100% Pure
notable_releases: Mumbling Yeah
short_bio: Amsterdam-based Dutch DJ/producer known in the minimal/tech house scene. He founded Bla Bla Records and gained wider attention with the late-2000s track Mumbling Yeah on Remote Area/100% Pure.

name: Dubfire
associated_labels: SCI+TEC; Cocoon Recordings; Toolroom Records; Minus; Ideal Audio
associated_acts: Deep Dish; Sharam; Oliver Huntemann; Miss Kittin
notable_releases: Roadkill; Ribcage; Grindhouse (with Oliver Huntemann); Diablo (with Oliver Huntemann); I Feel Speed
short_bio: Dubfire is the solo project of Iranian-American DJ and producer Ali Shirazinia, formerly one half of the Grammy-winning duo Deep Dish. Since 2006 he has focused on sleek, minimal-leaning techno, founding the SCI+TEC label and releasing tracks like Roadkill and Ribcage alongside collaborations with Oliver Huntemann. He is a prominent figure in the global techno scene.

name: GummiHz
short_bio: Greek DJ/producer known for releases on Mobilee Records and for running the Claap label, working in minimal/tech house.

name: Robag Wruhme
associated_labels: Pampa Records; Kompakt; Freude-Am-Tanzen; Musik Krause; Hart & Tief
notable_releases: Thora Vukk (album, 2011); Venq Tolep (album, 2019); Cybekks (EP, 2014); Wuzzelbud 'KK' (EP, 2004); Topinambur (EP, 2018)
short_bio: Robag Wruhme is the alias of German producer and DJ Gabor Schablitzki from Jena, known for a melodic, idiosyncratic strain of minimal techno and microhouse. He rose to prominence as half of Wighnomy Brothers alongside Monkey Maffia before focusing on solo work. He has released on Pampa Records, Kompakt and the Jena labels Freude-Am-Tanzen/Musik Krause, with highlights including the albums Thora Vukk and Venq Tolep and the Cybekks EP.

name: Pitto
notable_releases: Sexvibe
short_bio: Dutch DJ/producer working in the tech house/deep house sphere, associated with Joris Voorn and Edwin Oosterwal’s Rejected label. Known for the club track "Sexvibe."

name: Massimo Girardi
short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

name: TG
short_bio: TG is an alias of British producer Tim Green, used for stripped‑back minimal and tech house material.

name: Marc Ashken
short_bio: UK producer and DJ from London best known for releases on Leftroom and Leftroom Limited. His work sits in the minimal techno and tech house spectrum and was part of the UK minimal wave in the mid-to-late 2000s.

name: Paco Osuna
associated_acts: Marco Carola; Richie Hawtin; Adam Beyer; Christian Smith
short_bio: Spanish techno DJ and producer from Barcelona, and the founder of Mindshake Records. He co-founded Barcelona’s Club4 party alongside Marco Carola, Adam Beyer and Christian Smith, and has been a mainstay at Ibiza institutions such as Music On and ENTER.

name: Lusine
styles: IDM; ambient techno; microhouse; minimal techno
notable_releases: Serial Hodgepodge; A Certain Distance; The Waiting Room; Sensorimotor; Two Dots
short_bio: Lusine is the project of Seattle-based American producer Jeff McIlwain. Active since the late 1990s, he is known for emotive, precision-crafted electronics spanning IDM, ambient techno and microhouse, with key releases on Ghostly International and earlier work as Lusine ICL on Hymen Records. Notable albums include Serial Hodgepodge, A Certain Distance, The Waiting Room and Sensorimotor.

name: Lopazz
associated_labels: Get Physical Music; Output Recordings; Compost Black Label; Circle Music
notable_releases: I Need Ya; Share My Rhythm
short_bio: Lopazz is the moniker of Heidelberg-based producer Stefan Eichinger, closely associated with Get Physical since the early 2000s. He broke through with the single I Need Ya on Output and went on to craft leftfield house and tech‑house, frequently collaborating with Alex Flatner and Casio Casino.

name: Gaiser

short_bio: American minimal techno producer Jon Gaiser is a key artist on Richie Hawtin’s Minus label, known for sleek, percussive live sets and streamlined studio work.

name: Kabale und Liebe
notable_releases: Mumbling Yeah
short_bio: Dutch DJ/producer from Amsterdam associated with the minimal/tech-house scene. Best known for the track 'Mumbling Yeah' on Remote Area.

name: Ben Klock
notable_releases: One; Before One; Subzero; Berghain 04; Phantom Studies
short_bio: Berlin-based techno DJ and producer, longtime Berghain resident. Known for releases on Ostgut Ton and for running the Klockworks imprint. A key figure of modern Berlin techno since the mid-2000s.

name: Fatboy Slim
associated_labels: Skint Records; Astralwerks; Southern Fried Records
associated_acts: Beats International; Freak Power; The Housemartins; The Brighton Port Authority
notable_releases: Praise You; Right Here, Right Now; The Rockafeller Skank; Weapon of Choice; You've Come a Long Way, Baby
short_bio: Fatboy Slim is the big beat alias of British DJ and producer Norman Quentin Cook from Brighton. Breaking through on Skint Records in the late 1990s, he scored global hits like The Rockafeller Skank, Praise You and Weapon of Choice. Formerly of The Housemartins, he has also led projects such as Beats International, Pizzaman and Mighty Dub Katz.

name: Ambivalent
notable_releases: R U OK?
short_bio: Ambivalent is the techno alias of American producer/DJ Kevin McHugh. He broke through on Richie Hawtin’s Minus label in the late 2000s with the minimal anthem “R U OK?”, later launching his Valence imprint and exploring acid-leaning work as LA-4A.

short_bio: German DJ, producer and label owner based in Berlin. She co-founded mobilee records in 2005 and, after leaving in 2017, launched her own imprint Sous Music. A longtime radio host, she is a key figure in Europe’s tech house and minimal scenes.

short_bio: Kaiserdisco is a German duo from Hamburg comprising Frederic Berger and Patrick Buck. They are known for groove-led techno and tech house, founding the KD Music and KD RAW labels and releasing on Drumcode as well as MBF. Their early breakthrough included the track Aguja and the album In No One's Shadow.

name: Doomwork
short_bio: Doomwork is an electronic act focused on tech house and house.

name: Donnacha Costello
styles: minimal techno; deep house; microhouse; ambient techno
notable_releases: Together Is The New Alone; Colorseries
short_bio: Irish producer from Dublin known for warm, analog-leaning minimal techno and house. He ran the Minimise label, released early work with D1 Recordings, and issued the acclaimed album Together Is The New Alone on Mille Plateaux. He is also celebrated for the 2004 Colorseries run of 12-inches.

name: Traffic Signs
notable_releases: Infiltrate; The Big Fake; The Short Cut
short_bio: Traffic Signs is a stripped-down house/tech-house alias of German producer Steve Bug (Stefan Brügesch). The project delivered a run of club-focused 12-inches on the Traffic Signs imprint in the early-to-mid 2000s, including cuts like Infiltrate and The Big Fake.

name: Jorge Savoretti
styles: minimal house; tech house; minimal techno
short_bio: Argentine DJ and producer from Rosario, Jorge Savoretti is a key figure in his country’s minimal/house scene and co-runs the Savor Music label. His groove-led productions and DJ sets span minimal house and tech house, with releases on Savor Music and Germany’s Raum...musik.

name: Mihai Popoviciu

associated_acts: Hermannstadt Collective; Jay Bliss; Markus Homm

notable_releases: Home (album, Bondage Music)
short_bio: Mihai Popoviciu is a Romanian DJ and producer from Sibiu, known for sleek, groove-driven minimal and deep tech house. He has released on labels such as Highgrade Records, Poker Flat Recordings and Bondage Music, and is part of the Hermannstadt Collective with Jay Bliss; his album Home appeared on Bondage Music.

name: Moritz Piske

short_bio: Belgian producer/DJ known for minimal and tech house releases on Get Physical Music in the mid-2000s, including the club track Manta.

name: Tom Clark
short_bio: Berlin-based German DJ and producer known for minimal and tech house. He is closely associated with the Berlin label Highgrade Records.

name: Louderbach

name: Tiger Stripes

short_bio: Tiger Stripes is the alias of Swedish producer Mikael Nordgren from Stockholm. He emerged in the mid-2000s with a sound spanning house, tech house and techno, releasing on labels such as Get Physical and Ibadan. He has also collaborated with Jerome Sydenham.

name: Camea
short_bio: American-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer known for minimal techno and tech house. She founded the Clink Recordings imprint in the mid-2000s and later launched the Neverwhere label and radio show.

name: Drumcell
associated_acts: Cell Injection; Belief Defect; Audio Injection; Raíz; Luis Flores
notable_releases: Sleep Complex
short_bio: Drumcell is the Los Angeles–based techno artist Moe Espinosa, co-founder of the Droid Behavior collective and its Droid Recordings label. He is known for heavyweight, industrial-leaning techno with releases on CLR and Droid Recordings, and for projects such as Cell Injection and Belief Defect. Espinosa also explores ambient and experimental work under his Hypoxia alias.

name: Martini Bros
short_bio: Mærtini Brös is a Berlin-based German duo of DJ Clé and Mike Vamp, known for their tech house and minimal-leaning club productions. Active as producers and performers, they became fixtures of Germany's post-1990s club scene.

short_bio: Swedish-Chilean producer and DJ active since the mid-1990s, rooted in Stockholm’s techno and house scene. Known for minimal techno, tech house and deep house releases on labels like Svek, Truesoul and Plus 8, and for collaborations with Jesper Dahlbäck and Tony Rohr.

name: Richie Hawtin

associated_acts: John Acquaviva; Daniel Bell; Cybersonik; States of Mind; Pete Namlook; From Within

notable_releases: Plastikman - Spastik; Plastikman - Sheet One; Plastikman - Consumed; F.U.S.E. - Dimension Intrusion; Richie Hawtin - Decks, EFX & 909
short_bio: British-born Canadian DJ/producer Richie Hawtin is a pioneer of minimal techno, emerging from the Windsor–Detroit scene. He co-founded Plus 8 with John Acquaviva and later launched M_nus, while defining the genre with his Plastikman and F.U.S.E. projects. Landmark releases include Sheet One, Consumed, and the mix album Decks, EFX & 909.

name: Mark Brown
notable_releases: The Journey Continues (feat. Sarah Cracknell)
short_bio: UK house/tech house DJ and producer, founder of Cr2 Records, and one half of the duo MYNC/MYNC Project. Known for the crossover single The Journey Continues featuring Sarah Cracknell.

name: Audion
associated_labels: Spectral Sound; Ghostly International; Turbo Recordings
notable_releases: Mouth to Mouth; Suckfish; Kisses; Billy Says Go; Tiga vs Audion - Let's Go Dancing
short_bio: Audion is the minimal/techno alias of American producer Matthew Dear. Active since the mid-2000s on Ghostly International’s Spectral Sound imprint, he’s best known for the 2006 club anthem Mouth to Mouth and the album Suckfish. He has also collaborated with Tiga, notably on Let’s Go Dancing.

name: Mathew Jonson
associated_labels: Wagon Repair; Minus; Itiswhatitis; Crosstown Rebels

notable_releases: Decompression; Marionette; Her Blurry Pictures
short_bio: Canadian producer and live performer known for melodic, hardware-driven minimal techno. He co-founded Wagon Repair and is a core member of Cobblestone Jazz and The Modern Deep Left Quartet. Best known for classics like Decompression and Marionette, he has long been based in Berlin.

name: Xpansul
short_bio: Spanish techno and minimal producer/DJ active since the 2000s.

name: Tocadisco
notable_releases: Morumbi; Walking Away (Tocadisco Remix)
short_bio: German DJ and producer known for electro- and tech-house. He gained wide attention with his remix of The Egg's 'Walking Away', which became the basis of David Guetta's 'Love Don't Let Me Go (Walking Away)'. He has released on Toolroom Records and his own Toca45 imprint.

name: Mike Shannon
short_bio: Canadian minimal techno and tech house DJ/producer, best known as the founder of Cynosure Recordings.

name: Sascha Funke
notable_releases: Baby Kate; Bravo (album); Mango (album); Lotos Land (album)
short_bio: Berlin DJ and producer Sascha Funke is a key figure of Ellen Allien’s Bpitch Control, known for melodic minimal/tech house. He broke through with the club track Baby Kate and released albums including Bravo and Mango; later he formed the duo Saschienne and also issued work via Kompakt and Endless Flight.

name: Partycrashers

name: Sebastian Ingrosso

short_bio: Sebastian Ingrosso is a Swedish DJ and producer from Stockholm, co-founder of Swedish House Mafia with Axwell and Steve Angello. He runs Refune Records and is known for progressive house anthems like Reload and Calling (Lose My Mind). Active since the early 2000s.

name: Pheek
short_bio: Montreal-based producer and label owner Jean-Patrice Rémillard, aka Pheek, is a longstanding figure in minimal techno and microhouse. He founded the Archipel label and has released a substantial catalog of experimental, groove-led music.

name: Pan-Pot
associated_labels: Mobilee Records; Second State Audio; Watergate Records
notable_releases: Pan-O-Rama (album, 2007); The Other (album, 2015); Watergate 02 (DJ mix, 2008); Captain My Captain
short_bio: Pan-Pot is a Berlin-based German techno duo consisting of Tassilo Ippenberger and Thomas Benedix. They emerged in the mid-2000s on Mobilee Records and later founded the label Second State Audio, becoming mainstays of the international techno circuit. Their catalog includes the albums Pan-O-Rama and The Other, as well as the Watergate 02 mix.

name: MD3
aliases: MD3; MD-III; MD 3; Mike Dunn; MD X-Spress
notable_releases: The Pressure Cooker; Face The Nation
short_bio: MD III is an alias of Chicago house producer Mike Dunn, best known for late-1980s releases on Trax Records. Classic cuts like The Pressure Cooker and Face The Nation exemplify his raw Chicago sound.
